view_frame: The primary view is TOP (XY plane), showing the handle's footprint. The X-axis represents width, and the Y-axis represents depth. The Z-axis represents height (vertical). The drawing shows a U-shaped path in the XY plane. The 'END SECTION' view indicates the cross-section is circular with a diameter of 8 mm. The path lies in the XY plane, meaning the 'thickness' of the path in the top view corresponds to the diameter of the circular cross-section along the Z-axis.

features.placement: The path consists of two straight legs and one semicircular bend. The bend is centered at (0, 30) with a radius of 20 mm, spanning from angle 0 to 180 degrees (counter-clockwise). The left leg extends from (-20, 30) to (-20, 0). The right leg extends from (20, 30) to (20, 0). The entire path is lifted by the radius (4 mm) so the bottom of the handle rests at Z=0.
features.evidence: Top view shows a U-shape. Text 'Bend centreline R20; straight legs 30 mm' defines the geometry. 'END SECTION' shows a circle labeled 'diameter 8 mm'.

connections: The straight legs are tangent to the semicircular bend at the transition points (-20, 30) and (20, 30).
edit_rules: Changing the 'diameter' updates the cross-section size and the vertical offset of the path.
Changing 'R20' updates the width of the handle and the curvature of the bend.
Changing '30 mm' updates the length of the straight legs.
